author: Scar1203
quote:
If this was anything else I'd say it met expectations, but for the next installment of GTA, a game we've all been waiting for since 2013 it just doesn't do enough.

It runs poorly, the characters are boring and one dimensional, the writing is bland, and it just doesn't live up to expectations. If it weren't GTA then I'd give it a pass just for being an entertaining enough sandbox, but it is GTA and as such this installment gets a zero and it pains me to give it that score.
